summary: CenterPoint Energy Houston Electric, LLC filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, reporting an Underwriting Agreement with Barclays, BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs, MUFG and Truist as representatives for an underwritten public offering of $700 million aggregate principal amount of 5.40% General Mortgage Bonds, Series AS, due 2031. The bonds were issued under the company's General Mortgage Indenture, as supplemented by the Fortieth Supplemental Indenture dated September 24, 2026, pursuant to an effective Form S-3 shelf registration. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
